name: prompt-optimizer
description: /optimize rewrites a draft prompt with repo context and fills it into the composer

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: Which model rewrites the draft. sonnet is the default; haiku is faster but drifts from the draft more often; opus is the most careful.

instructions.title: Extra instructions
instructions.description: Added to the rewrite rules, such as a house style every rewritten prompt should follow. Empty adds nothing.
